description: "The input" is the message input [data-testid="message-input"]; "the picker" is the skill picker [data-testid="skill-picker"]; its options are its [role="option"] elements; "the chip" is [data-testid="skill-chip"]. On a phone, the MCP tools named "search" stay distinct by their server badges, and both can be selected. The page lists MCP servers web and library, each with a tool "search" described "Search <server> sources", and locked, whose tools fail to load. Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /c/skills. 2. For each server S of "web", then "library": fill the input with "/skills S search"; there should be exactly one option; the picker's ".skill-mcp-badge" text should be exactly S, and its ".skill-picker-description" text exactly "Search S sources"; click the option. 3.
